error_message: Panics on config load failure — unwrap_or_else(panic!) in game_setup.rs load_ron_file crashes the game if config is missing or malformed
root_cause: load_ron_file uses unwrap_or_else(|| panic!(...)) on the RON deserialization result, causing an unrecoverable crash when config files are missing, have syntax errors, or schema-drift
prevention_rule: PREVENT-SB-001: unwrap_or_else(panic!) in config loading — return Result and propagate errors to a graceful fallback screen, never crash on config failure

error_message: Trojan enemy reuses swarm texture — 'reuse swarm for now' comment indicates placeholder art was never replaced
root_cause: The Trojan enemy type was shipped using the swarm enemy's texture as a temporary placeholder, but the placeholder was never replaced with dedicated art, making the Trojan visually indistinguishable from swarm enemies
prevention_rule: PREVENT-SB-002: Placeholder asset reuse with 'for now' comment — track all placeholder assets and add CI check for 'reuse.*for now' comments near asset loading

error_message: Config files loaded from relative paths — same pattern as BiteClub, resolves against CWD not executable
root_cause: RON config files are loaded via relative paths like 'config/game.ron' which resolve against the process working directory, causing config load failures when the game is launched from a different directory
prevention_rule: PREVENT-SB-003: Relative file paths for config — use dirs::config_dir() or std::env::current_exe() with parent() to resolve absolute paths for game configuration
